claims.head: The Kings will send Doughty and Edmundson at Stützle
claims.call: The Kings’ P2 (Doughty and Edmundson) spends at least 35% of its 5-on-5 time against the Senators’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Kings keep sending Doughty and Edmundson out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Peter Laviolette has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Senators’ first line is Zetterlund, Stützle and Giroux.

LAK.head: A slightly uphill night for the Kings
LAK.body: Even though Los Angeles has home-ice advantage, Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents lately, and the Kings will be without Fiala. The Kings can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

OTT.head: The Senators start a half-step ahead
OTT.body: Even though Los Angeles has home-ice advantage, Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents lately, and the Kings will be without Fiala. Still, it’s close: the Kings can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

items.text: The Senators are newly without Linus Ullmark, and have been without Thomas Chabot and William Eklund for several games. Jonas Johansson is expected to start.
Artemi Panarin has a point in eight straight games against Ottawa, and 14 points in his last eight against them.
The Kings are newly without Mats Zuccarello, have been without Alex Turcotte since Oct 6, and have had to make do without Kevin Fiala all season.
Drew Doughty has missed the Kings’ latest game.
